rejected.reason: The PRD asks for 'The channel of the link: email, LinkedIn, SMS, or WhatsApp'. A forwarded link is the same link, so recording the channel that the analyst used (c=whatsapp) matches the PRD. Removing c would record 'direct', which is also not the real channel of the recipient. The second-channel rule uses the channel of the first session, and that is almost always the owner's own session, because a forward happens after an open. This is an attribution preference, not a defect with a concrete failure.

The PRD does not mention analyst time zones, and the profile menu list in the PRD does not include one. Architecture decision 3 and the analysts schema in architecture.md set Europe/Helsinki as the default on purpose, and PATCH /api/analysts accepts timeZone. No file in the repo says that Jonas Weber works in Berlin, so the claimed failure is based on an assumption. The result for the German owner (slots from 08:00 to 15:00 in Berlin) is still within business hours. This is an admin panel improvement and not a video page defect.

PRD line 267 says 'The demo has no sign-in ... Run the demo on a private address only', so the open admin API is a PRD decision. The deal ID adds no access: GET http://localhost:3000/api/deals (checked) lists every deal ID without authentication, and the Pipedrive IDs (4001 to 4007) are sequential and easy to guess. The PRD requires only that the link code is not the deal ID, and that is true. An unused field in VideoPageData is a cleanup, not a privacy defect.

The claimed failure path does not exist. player.tsx:54 canFullscreen returns false on iPhone, the video has no controls attribute and has playsInline, and the player never calls webkitEnterFullscreen. So the iPhone never shows the native player or its captions menu with the unnamed track. On other platforms the custom captions toggle (setCaptionMode on textTracks[0]) turns the captions on and off, and they render. WCAG 2.2 A and HTML do not require srclang or label for kind=captions (the language of parts is 3.1.2, level AA). Adding videoLanguage is a small improvement, not a defect.

These are style preferences, and no string is wrong. 'Kuka Mergero on' is an understandable calque of the English heading. 'Keskeytä video' is a normal Finnish label for pause. 'Alaraja {low}, yläraja {high}' is correct and clear. The filled Nordic texts are grammatical: Intl gives 'Ditt möte är bokat måndag 28 september kl. 14:00 ... med X', and a date after 'bokat' or 'booket' with no preposition is normal in Swedish, Norwegian and Danish. The contact addresses are the real addresses from mergero.com (config/mergero.json), and the Finnish and Swiss addresses are also written in English, so this is a consistent choice and not an error on the German page only.

Examples: POST /api/deals/:id/approve (publishes the prospect link and moves the Pipedrive stage), POST /api/tasks/:id/done, POST /api/jobs/:id/retry, POST /api/deals/:id/ensure, and the multipart uploads POST /api/analysts/:id/voice and /consent (these replace the voice sample or the signed consent PDF and date).
